posts.title: tmux-jumpsuite: A Tmux plugin to jump to things
posts.description: Tmux Jumpsuite is a very simple plugin that displays a context-aware list of available actions for the current pane. So far, it's pretty basic, and mostly geared around quickly jumping from tmux to Github (in the default browser), but hey it's a start.
